audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 1 and 4 said Lillia or Skill under why lines that describe losing — whys[0] 'you can't punish her step-up', whys[4] 'your only 6 spike is neutralized' — and row 6 said Fiora under a why that says 'at 2+ items your AP and roam tempo finally give you an out'.
audit.why: The mirror is already committed: fiora__lillia.json moved phases[0], [1] and [4] to Fiora and phases[6] to Skill, giving Fiora/Fiora/Fiora/Fiora/Fiora/Fiora/Skill — the packet chart exactly. Four of my rows disagreed with it.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1 and 4 to Fiora and row 6 to Skill, in matched full/content pairs, with ratings 3 across her six stages and 5 on the even one.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer still sold Level 6 as your spike and 'ganks are now guaranteed'.
audit.why: Fiora has both answers to a 150s drowsy-then-sleep: Lunge (13/11.25/9.5/7.75/6s) simply leaves the area during the drowsy delay, and Riposte parries damage and disables for a window on a 24s rank-1 cooldown. Neither is a spike for you.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names Riposte's 24s and Lunge as the two outs; phases[6].why states your genuine out, which is leaving the 1v1 entirely.

audit.whatIsWrong: TWO problems. (a) Packet defect: the full layer never names Lunge, Duelist's Dance, Bladework or Grand Challenge — only Riposte. (b) breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t all state flatly that Riposte 'parries your damage and CC, then stuns'. That is not what Riot says.
audit.why: Riot: Riposte parries all incoming damage and disables, then stabs — the stab SLOWS the first champion hit, and stuns them ONLY if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect with it. Stated unconditionally, a player believes every parried trade ends in a stun.
audit.corrected: Real names added across the level-chart whys; the conditional stun written correctly into dosFull[0].d and report[5].t.

audit.why: packet.suspectNames flags 'Your Lilting Lullaby' and "Lilting Lullaby's" as probable wrong names. Both are FALSE POSITIVES — that is the correct name of Lillia's R. No change made.

edits.before: Q's outer ring on his last-hits plus the passive speed means he literally cannot touch you at level 1.
edits.after: Lunge closes the gap your Q speed relies on — one ability at level 1 cannot punish her step-up.

edits.before: W sweetspot threat starts — anyone chasing you eats the big hit while your Dream Dust burns their HP bar.
edits.after: She layers a second Lunge and a Duelist's Dance vital before your Dream Dust burn matters at all.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-kite in circles, E from fog for the slow, and the passive speed makes every trade yours to end.
edits.after: Swirlseed slows, but she Lunges through it and Bladework out-trades your still-ramping Dream Dust burn.

edits.before: The lane is a treadmill he can't get off — Q every step-up, kite the Riposte window, and bank Dream Dust burn.
edits.after: Your grind window is dead — she Lunges instead of walking, so the burn never compounds on her at all.

edits.before: Lilting Lullaby online — your jungler's ganks are now guaranteed, and any overstep becomes a sleep-execute.
edits.after: Riposte parries damage and disables for 24s at rank 1, and Lunge leaves the drowsy delay behind.

edits.before: Liandry's spike — Dream Dust plus the burn melts juggernauts and tanks alike while you jog circles around them.
edits.after: Liandry's comes online, but Duelist's Dance vitals out-trade the burn in any extended fight she chooses.

edits.before: You're a teamfight nightmare now: sleep two, kite the rest, and let the burn do the bookkeeping.
edits.after: Even at last — leave the 1v1, roam on your speed, and let the team answer her splitpush.

edits.before: Parries your damage and CC, then stuns — never lead with CC into it. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Parries damage and disables for 24s at rank 1; the return stab stuns only if it blocked an immobilise.

edits.before: Track Fiora’s Riposte: Parries your damage and CC, then stuns — never lead with CC into it. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Riposte's 24s: it parries damage and disables, and the return stab only stuns if it blocked an immobilising effect.

notes: UNVERIFIED, deliberately left alone: four content fields (whys[4], spikes[1], mid, wants.you[1]) claim Riposte parries Lilting Lullaby's drowsy or sleep into a return STUN. Riot's text supports the parry itself — Riposte 'parries all incoming damage and disables' — but the return stun fires only when it blocked an IMMOBILIZING effect, and nothing in the kits says whether drowsy (a slow) or the sleep qualifies. The mirror flagged the same four fields. I wrote the conditional correctly in the two full-layer strings I did edit and made no claim either way in the new text; the four content strings need a source before they are touched. Chart now matches fiora__lillia.json exactly. The full layer also uses he/his for Fiora throughout — tldr, dosFull[0].t and dontsFull[0].t all say 'his dash' — flagged for a pronoun pass.
